tui.goal.tip: runs with gates, review, and profile sandbox
goal.plan: Run %s: %s via %s (reviewer: %s). Agent sandbox follows the %s profile; GasaCLI retains project, gate, network, and Git checks.
goal.gates.none: No verification gates are configured. Add test, build, or lint commands to gasacli/config.yaml, then start the run again.
goal.cli.no_tty: Approval required for %s on %s; run this command in an interactive terminal.
goal.approval.help: Use left/right and Enter. Default: Deny.
tui.quit.active: An orchestration run is active. Cancel it and quit?
goal.agent.profile: Agent execution uses the selected profile sandbox. GasaCLI still checks project writes, configured gates, network access, and Git mutations.
